checks.details: Correct fixture passed, deliberately wrong fixture failed, repaired fixture passed.

checks.name: initial
checks.details: Icarus 12 compilation and simulation passed; 2354 steps, all ten listed transitions, all 256 eight-bit sequences, and synchronous reset checks from every listed state with both input values.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
Original specification does not define power-on state or states 101, 110, 111. Testbench imposes no output requirement before first reset and does not test unspecified states.
Contract validation establishes structure only, not functional correctness.

justified_rtl_tb_changes.initial_implementation: Direct three-bit state implementation of original transition and Moore output table, with synchronous active-high reset. Initial snapshot preserved before checks.
justified_rtl_tb_changes.oracle: Independent integer model follows original table; checks output before edges and after updates, including off-edge reset pulses.
